title: Omega Bio-Tek Mag-Bind Environmental DNA 96 Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Open the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware, and select your labware files (JSON extensions) if needed.

substeps.instruction: Browse to and select the required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to the Protocol tab and upload your protocol file with a .py extension.

substeps.instruction: Open the Protocol tab in the OT App.
Select the .py file containing your protocol.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing each labware in its designated slot.

substeps.instruction: Refer to the deck map supplied with the protocol.
Place each piece of labware in the indicated deck slot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tiprack, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

substeps.instruction: Open the calibration routine in the OT App.
Review support articles for additional guidance.
